spike_plan.kill_if: Suite is flaky or cannot run offline, the Commands/Coder APIs cannot be driven with a stub model, or the spec's precedence rules leave two reasonable designs with different outputs (then tighten the spec first).
spike_plan.pass_if: Install and suite run offline and are green, harness is deterministic over three runs, and a markdown command resolves through a dispatch hook that needs no core rewrite.
steps: In a networked throwaway Linux container, clone Aider-AI/aider at 5dc9490 and install it in a venv; record the time and whether the install succeeds.
Run the existing pytest suite (commands and coder tests first, then full) twice; record pass/fail per test to check determinism and whether it runs offline.
Write a 40-line harness that builds a Coder with a stub model and drives Commands.run for /add, /help and a dummy command, then diffs the chat context and written files across three runs.
Locate the command dispatch point in aider/commands.py and confirm a markdown-defined command can be resolved there without changing core files.
Check that a fake read-only plan mode can block an edit in the Coder path using only the public API.
Record minutes spent and write the outcome.

v1.summary: Aider v0.86.0 at 5dc9490 is a real Apache-2.0 base, and no public release or PR found implements the four requested features, so lookup is none. Two issues need fixing before the seed proceeds: the cited issue does not contain the four-feature spec and its reaction and comment counts are contradicted, and the smoke build is empty, so the offline build is unverified; a 55-minute spike should confirm both.

v2.note: Repo, commit and Apache-2.0 licence are confirmed. The paper trail does not hold up: V1 could not find issue #3362 asking for the four features, and the upvote and comment counts are contradicted. The spec is our own design that copies Claude Code features, which agents know well. The work is DeepSWE-style feature additions in a popular repo, about 1-1.5k lines across four shallow features (markdown command dispatch, loading a memory file, an edit-blocking flag, a todo command). An excellent agent likely finishes in about 1-1.5 h of the 4 h tier, and a weaker model can probably handle commands and todo. Grading uses a few dozen hand-written scripted sessions run through internal Commands/Coder APIs, so the surface is small, and pinning hook points risks rejecting valid designs. Sibling seeds S-im-109 and S-im-110 (cosine around 0.4) are probably also aider features, which adds K1 risk.
